en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Abbas Bin Marouf, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Rabie, from Fuzayl, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is upon you with the brilliant ones from the wet-nurses, for the milk affects’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-‘ Abbas ibn Ma’ruf Hammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Haytham from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘
You can use the milk of a horse for your child but you must remain on your guard against the milk of a fornicator; milk may spread.’”
